title: Enterprise security questionnaire kit and attestation bundling for pricing experiments
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a reusable "Security Questionnaire Kit" and an operational playbook for producing customer attestation letters to support enterprise pricing/packaging experiments. The kit will include pre-filled CAIQ (Consensus Assessment Initiative Questionnaire) answers tailored for Redwood Inference hosting modes (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private), a short SOC2 summary snippet, recommended evidence attachments, and a templated attestation letter for sales/legal to sign. The goal is to shorten sales cycle for customers requiring detailed security responses, enable A/B testing of bundling attestation with paid tiers (eg. include attestation for annual Dedicated commits vs sell as add-on), and automate generation of customer-facing artifacts from a single master source so answers stay consistent across proposals. Scope: product + security + legal + engineering for automation integration. Deliverables: Confluence kit, Drive templates, onboarding automation spec, sales playbook & pricing experiment plan, and a small UI change request to allow selecting "include attestation" during contract creation.

acceptance_criteria: Canonical CAIQ answers completed and approved by Security and Legal for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private variants
Attestation letter template approved by Legal with issuance/expiry/revocation fields
Automated export endpoint can produce a zipped customer package (answers + evidence checklist + attestation PDF) behind RBAC
Sales quote tool shows an "include attestation" option and emits CRM events for A/B experiment measurement
Pilot executed with 10 AEs and instrumentation captures time-to-contract and RFP win signals for initial analysis
notes_for_eng: ENG-5022: produce evidence export hooks for KMS/HSM metadata without exposing sensitive OPs keys
ENG-5110: implement JSON schema and export endpoint; ensure generation includes a signed manifest and audit trace
SEC-221: ensure generated packages are logged to audit store and access-controlled; recommend short-lived signed URLs for delivery
sales_playbook_snippet: When a prospect requests a security questionnaire, offer the CAIQ kit and ask if they need a signed attestation. If the prospect is in the pilot cohort and chooses "include attestation" default the attestation into the quote for annual Dedicated commits.
If evidence requests exceed kit scope, escalate to Security SWAT with ticket reference and expected SLA: 3 business days for standard artifacts.
